fields.name: node_uuid
fields.description: Node UUID bytes in RFC 4122 byte order.

fields.name: fault_id
fields.description: Random identifier used to deduplicate retransmitted faults.

fields.name: sample_id
fields.description: Reading sample id associated with the fault, or UINT32_MAX when unavailable.

fields.name: bootno
fields.description: Boot number on which the fault was first observed.

fields.name: operation
fields.description: Stable Cura operation that observed the failure.

fields.name: esp_err
fields.description: ESP-IDF error code, or ESP_OK when not applicable.

fields.name: posix_errno
fields.description: POSIX errno captured immediately after failure, or 0 when not applicable.
